title: pvPolylineLength
body:
## pvPolylineLength

Adds a point array named arc_length holding, at each point of a polyline, the distance travelled along that polyline from its first point; points of other cell types get 0. The output is the same polydata. Use it after probeLine, a streamline or a contour to plot values against distance along the curve.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- VTK assumes cells do not share points; where polylines share a point it can hold only one of the lengths.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PolylineLength`. Identity: `filters/PolylineLength`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
